tools.name: smartbill_list_series
tools.description: List the document series configured in SmartBill Cloud with their next number. Invoice and proforma tools need a series name from here. type: f = invoice series, p = proforma, c = receipt (chitanta); omit for all. GET /series.

tools.name: smartbill_list_taxes
tools.description: List the VAT rates configured in the account (name and percentage). Use the name as tax_name and the percentage as tax_percentage on document lines. Works without a V3 token. GET /tax.

tools.name: smartbill_get_stock
tools.description: Stock quantities per warehouse as of a date (needs the SmartBill stock module). Optional filters: warehouse_name (case-sensitive), product_name, product_code. No filters = all products in all warehouses. GET /stocks.

tools.name: smartbill_get_invoice_payment_status
tools.description: Whether an invoice is paid and how much remains: invoiceTotalAmount, paidAmount, unpaidAmount and the paid flag. GET /invoice/paymentstatus.

tools.name: smartbill_get_estimate_invoices
tools.description: Whether a proforma was invoiced and the invoices (series, number) made from it. A draft invoice shows with an empty number. GET /estimate/invoices.

tools.name: smartbill_list_clients
tools.description: List clients from the SmartBill client list, optionally filtered by name (partial, case-insensitive), internal code (exact) or CIF (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/clients.

tools.name: smartbill_get_client
tools.description: One client by V3 id (cus_...): name, CIF, address, bank, contact, VAT-payer flag and delivery addresses. Needs the API V3 token. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/clients/{id}.

tools.name: smartbill_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, optionally filtered by name (partial), internal code (exact) or CIF (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/suppliers.

tools.name: smartbill_get_supplier
tools.description: One supplier by V3 id (sup_...). Needs the API V3 token. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: smartbill_list_products
tools.description: List the product and service catalog (price, unit, VAT rate, currency), optionally filtered by name (whole-word match) or internal code (exact). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/products.

tools.name: smartbill_get_product
tools.description: One product or service by V3 id (prod_...). Needs the API V3 token. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/products/{id}.

tools.name: smartbill_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (name, type en gros / en detail, keeper, address). Needs the API V3 token. Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/warehouses.

tools.name: smartbill_list_vat_rates
tools.description: List VAT rates with ids, name, percentage and reverse-charge flag. Filter by name (partial) or percentage (exact). Needs the API V3 token (smartbill_list_taxes does the same without it). Cursor paged: pass the reply's next_args as the next call's arguments. GET /v3/companies/{cif}/vat-rates.

tools.name: smartbill_create_invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for a client with product/service lines. By default it is saved as a DRAFT (no number) for review in SmartBill Cloud. With draft=false the invoice is ISSUED: it takes the next number of the series, cannot be deleted or edited through this server, can only be cancelled or reversed (

tools.name: smartbill_create_invoice_from_estimate
tools.description: Create an invoice from an existing proforma (client and lines are copied from it). Default is a DRAFT; with draft=false the invoice is ISSUED with the next number of the series and may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF. Stock is not discharged. POST /invoice/v2 (useEstimateDetails).

tools.name: smartbill_create_estimate
tools.description: Create a proforma (estimate) for a client with product/service lines. Default is a DRAFT (no number); with draft=false it takes the next number of the proforma series. A proforma is not a fiscal invoice. Returns series, number, documentId and links. POST /estimate/v2.

tools.name: smartbill_reverse_invoice
tools.description: ISSUE a storno (credit) invoice that reverses an issued invoice. It takes the next number, an invoice can be reversed only once, and the storno cannot be undone; it may be transmitted to e-Factura / ANAF. Confirm the exact series and number with the user first. POST /invoice/reverse.

tools.name: smartbill_cancel_invoice
tools.description: Cancel an existing invoice (it stays in the books as cancelled; smartbill_restore_invoice undoes it). Changes the document's fiscal status, so confirm with the user. PUT /invoice/cancel.

tools.name: smartbill_restore_invoice
tools.description: Restore an invoice that was cancelled, making it active again. PUT /invoice/restore.

tools.name: smartbill_cancel_estimate
tools.description: Cancel an existing proforma (smartbill_restore_estimate undoes it). PUT /estimate/cancel.

tools.name: smartbill_restore_estimate
tools.description: Restore a proforma that was cancelled. PUT /estimate/restore.

tools.name: smartbill_record_invoice_payment
tools.description: Record a collection (incasare) against one or more issued invoices; client and amount are taken from the invoices. With value (single invoice only) a partial payment is recorded. type Chitanta issues a numbered RECEIPT on receipt_series (cannot be undone from this server); the other types (Card, Ord

tools.name: smartbill_send_document
tools.description: Send an issued invoice or proforma by email from SmartBill. This EMAILS A THIRD PARTY and cannot be recalled. Without `to` it goes to the client's email on the document; without subject/body_text the account's email template is used. Confirm the recipient with the user first. POST /document/send.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "smartbill_list_clients" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
